name: Worshipping Mary
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that worship and praise belong solely to God, who forbids the making or worshipping of graven images or likenesses of anything in heaven or on earth, as stated in Exodus 20:4 and Isaiah 42:8. The practice of offering reverence to the 'queen of heaven' through rituals is condemned in Jeremiah 7:18 as provoking God's anger. While Mary is acknowledged as the mother of Jesus, as in Luke 11:27, salvation and access to the Father come only through faith in Jesus Christ, who declares Himself the way, the truth, and the life in John 14:6. Therefore, elevating Mary to a position of worship contradicts the exclusive devotion Scripture commands toward Christ alone.
